## Goal
See GP-12 in COPILOT_PROPOSALS.md: a 'Try it locally' section per channel (exact commands, hashes still placeholders, channel 'coming', unrun commands labelled unverified). Create distro/winget/README.md and distro/scoop/README.md if missing.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Every product statement cites a repo file or is marked 'not sure'; nothing called 'available' unless site_src/data/release.yaml lists it.
- Plain words; fake people only.
- Create no files outside the allowed paths.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- distro/aur/README.md
- distro/flatpak/README.md
- distro/homebrew/README.md
- distro/nix/README.md
- distro/winget/README.md
- distro/scoop/README.md
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
src/, packaging/, every file not listed above.
